packageRole: V56 R7.2 forward continuity working checkpoint S24 — NOT MASTER pending Cameron approval and explicit promotion
principle: The approved current build is a one-way baseline. Previously approved structure and behaviour may change only after explicit user instruction. Old-build behaviour must be removed or permanently gated, never allowed to revive through stale code/CSS.
requiredVisualGuards: Home fixed one-screen/no Home map/no Home Next Destination
Main supplied header artwork uses recognisable low-crop presentation; helper heroes use contain where needed to prevent over-zoom
Add Expense is a visible top-level light-blue Budget action and its editor remains light blue while category tiles retain category accents
Budget has no separate visible Verify Budget action; canonical Budget integrity remains inside App Health.
Each widget and its expanded/drill-down view uses one coherent feature-colour family except meaningful semantic status colours
Calendar destination spans use subtle destination identity colour
Itinerary and Calendar share destination colour identity
Journey/route maps remain zoomable and pannable on iPad, with explicit expansion separated from map gestures
Locked Vault retains the approved cool cyan/metallic vault-door treatment before three-tap unlock
Completed reservation, itinerary and checklist surfaces use neutral silver/slate rather than green/teal.
Calendar month view uses thin destination/travel identity rails in the date cells, compact event cards, and +N more expansion rather than thick continuous bars.
Vault and Settings use the current corrected header system; Build 1 Vault/Settings screenshots are local visual/content benchmarks only, not global sidebar/layout authority.
Settings App Health uses the Build 1-inspired ambulance plus heartbeat/pulse-line treatment while preserving the current 9/9 canonical checks.
Search fields use neutral graphite/silver treatment; colour variety is restrained and not dominated by green, blue or purple.
Streaming remains a secondary protected Vault section and uses restrained graphite rather than a dominant purple surface.
Home Alerts use red / amber / green traffic-light dots beside the severity label; the expanded list stays concise and Kym-first.
Where local currency is primary, the AUD equivalent remains clearly labelled and readable as secondary information on Home and every other mixed-currency surface.
Information widgets and expanded views are content-driven: sparse information must not be stretched into large dead/empty slabs.
The approved semantic colour system applies consistently to every main screen and secondary/expanded view; neutral search and Completed surfaces stay neutral.
requiredInteractionGuards: Budget exposes no separate Verify Budget control; App Health runs the canonical Budget integrity check.
Home Upcoming Events first tap expands complete list
Home Alerts first tap expands complete list
Calendar coloured item/strip tap opens the exact tapped record directly; explicit date-header control or blank day area opens full Day View
Calendar date, event and period controls remain pointer-interactive and at least 44px touch-friendly on the audited iPad layouts
Recent Expense Entries first tap expands complete list; second row tap edits
Vault unlock requires three taps on physical door
Where's the toilet and Country Quick Look close without app restart and do not scroll
Maps support zoom and pan; map gestures do not accidentally trigger card expansion
Standard Add Destination has no route/coordinate fields; Motorhome/Cruise alone keep route stops
RV/Cruise identity uses Starting Country across banner, Budget, Calendar, Journey Map, search and planning statistics
Saved booked flights may cover an otherwise empty overnight transit day; To Book flights do not suppress real planning gaps
PIN digits are masked while retaining numeric keypad behaviour
Changing a stay fixed exchange rate before Destination Budget expenses exist recalculates linked same-local-currency reservation AUD amounts; manual cross-currency equivalents are preserved
Travel Year controls support a scalable minimum 30-year horizon, extend beyond Year 30 when later data exists, and preserve multi-select filtering.

Standard destinations, route Starting Cities, and route stops never require typed latitude/longitude: known places resolve offline and unknown places require deliberate offline-map placement before Save.
Missing/null map coordinates must never be treated as 0,0; manual map corrections remain authoritative and migration repairs known partial coordinates while clearing unknown partial coordinates.
Itinerary Upcoming, Completed and enlarged Upcoming histories render at most 20 records per page while exact-record navigation opens the page containing the target stay.
Travel Year previous/next navigation skips empty sparse-year windows and jumps to the nearest populated year block while preserving multi-select state.
Every live Add Reservation type—Flights, Trains, Cruises, RV/Motorhome, Hotels, Airbnb and Tickets & Attractions—offers both Annual-only and exact-stay Destination Budget allocation.
A Destination Budget reservation uses the exact dated stay and also rolls into the annual travel total; Annual-only reservations do not consume the stay Destination Budget.
Reservations Next 5 expands the reservation widget in place and does not navigate to another screen or open an editor.
Add Reservation retains Undo, visible AUD conversion/equivalent, simplified help copy, and a fixed usable footer at both audited iPad widths.
Calendar +N more and date/blank-area controls open the full day; exact event taps continue to open the exact record.
Home compass Phrase Helper and Current Destination Country Quick Look are separate entry points and must not cross-link to each other.
Expanded Home Alerts use traffic-light severity markers and Remove only; no alert row may navigate to another screen.
Removing an alert hides only the Home warning and never deletes or mutates its source record.

fullBuildProtocolSummary: Start only from newest sealed continuity master.
Read the embedded protocol and release contract before editing.
No unrelated redesign during defect fixes; preserve approved structure and current Home-led premium material authority.
Remove/quarantine obsolete legacy code; do not rely on later CSS overrides to hide it.
Run forbidden-regression, structural-presence, colour-authority, interaction-path, data-integrity, offline-shell and physical-iPad gates before promotion.

Create a new continuity master only when Cameron requests it.

sourceProvenance.sourceSealRootAlgorithm: sha256 of sorted name:hash lines from the R7.1 stored seal
sourceProvenance.promotionReason: Deep forward audit of the actual R7.1 master found four surviving continuity defects: sparse long-horizon year browsing could land on empty six-year blocks; Calendar day cells exposed a parent interactive role around child event buttons in VoiceOver; several non-Home operational controls retained micro text/tap sizes; and the PWA manifest still carried a stale R6 release description. These were fixed and regression-tested forward as R7.2 without rolling back any R7.1 reservation, budget, storage or offline-launch repair.

continuationRepairs: Budget colour chains aligned across Annual Budget, Living Expenses, Recent Expenses, Add Expense and Destination Budget drill-downs; Add Expense remains light blue while category tiles stay differentiated.

Settings Backup, Vault summaries/activity/emergency card, Checklist overview/Next Destination, Journey History summaries/maps/milestones and Home expanded internals aligned to coherent parent colour families; semantic red/green retained only where meaningful.
Removed stale legacy Home/Vault/Calendar CSS authorities and obsolete suppressed components rather than relying on later overrides.
Calendar month strips are real interactive controls opening the exact tapped item; blank/date area still opens Day View; obsolete pointer-inert/day-first guard contradiction removed.
Journey Map gestures are separated from expansion; collapsed map uses key labels, expanded map uses all labels and fit-to-route.
Reservation Health Check restored as an expandable operational view.
Settings PIN input masks digits; Accounts copy correctly labels AUD subtotal; Add Reservation copy matches the locked light-blue workflow.

Country identity unified across automatic currency, flags, outlines, Quick Look, phrase helper, launch and headers; natural The Bahamas/The Netherlands/The Philippines/The United Kingdom aliases added; dedicated silhouettes added for Liechtenstein, Malta, Monaco and Singapore.
Quick Look/Phrase Helper and Checklist expanded destination heroes no longer recreate over-zoomed/cropped header treatment.
Itinerary Destination/Starting City Map Point Save path preserves newly selected coordinates.

RV/Cruise Starting Country is authoritative across banner, Budget, Itinerary view model, Calendar, Journey Map, Global Search and Countries Planned; Standard-to-route conversion clears stale Standard country and restored stale country no longer inflates planning statistics.

Destination Budget fixed-rate correction recalculates linked same-local-currency reservations atomically before Destination Budget expenses lock the rate; cross-currency manual AUD equivalents are not silently overwritten.
Forward Coverage accepts a saved booked flight as a Flight Transit day when it is otherwise uncovered; To Book flights never suppress genuine gaps.
Working-copy guard mode validates intentional changes without weakening the final sealed-file integrity gate.

Reservation budget routing is now explicit for every live booking type: Flights, Trains, Cruises, RV/Motorhome, Hotels, Airbnb and Tickets & Attractions each offer Annual-only or exact-stay Destination Budget allocation. Destination-scoped costs also roll into the annual travel total.

Annual reservations may be saved on a valid uncovered transit day. A booked flight can therefore fill a Flight Transit day without requiring a fake stay or Destination Budget; To Book continues not to suppress itinerary gaps.

Annual-only reservation stay links are contextual only. Deleting a stay safely clears those links while preserving the Annual-only reservation; every destination-scoped reservation type remains protected by its exact stay relationship.
Legacy reservations without budgetScope migrate deterministically: major booking types become annual, Tickets & Attractions retain destination allocation when their dated stay is valid.
Service-worker registration/update work is fully non-blocking after the app is already rendered; installed offline launch never awaits a network or worker update probe.

Budget current-stay Reservations remains a complete read-only booking context: Annual-only and Destination-scoped bookings linked to the stay are visible; only Destination-scoped reservations consume the stay Destination Budget, while all real costs still roll into the annual total.

Checklist repeat-trip state verified by stay ID: destination-specific checklist records remain separate for repeated destinations and permanent-item completion history is scoped independently to each move/stay.

Calendar same-day aggregation verified: destination/travel periods, reservations and personal notes/reminders sharing one date all remain present in the month cell and Agenda rather than collapsing to a single item.
Long-horizon Travel Year paging now jumps to the nearest previous/next populated six-year block, so sparse years such as 1, 5, 12, 20 and 30 never force Kym through empty year pages.

Calendar month day cells no longer expose a parent button role around nested event buttons. Each day is an accessible group with an explicit date-header Day View button; blank-area taps and exact event taps retain their existing behaviour.

Targeted non-Home iPad readability hardening raises key operational year, paging, Calendar event/date, Checklist add and Vault lock controls to practical touch/text sizes without changing Home’s locked fixed-screen composition.
The PWA manifest release description now identifies V56 R7.2 instead of the stale R6 checkpoint, keeping install/update identity aligned with the current sealed master.
Removed the superseded visible Verify Budget workflow. Canonical Budget integrity remains available through Settings → App Health, while Add Expense stays the visible Budget action.

12 September colour/readability audit: Completed surfaces are neutral silver/slate, search is graphite/silver, Streaming is restrained graphite, semantic travel modes remain Standard blue / Motorhome orange / Cruise violet, and audited labels were enlarged where needed.
12 September iPad containment audit: all nine screens were rendered at 1194×834 and 1024×768 with no horizontal overflow; Add Expense normal entry fits without body scrolling at both target sizes.
12 September forensic continuity hardening: removed the dormant Quick Look/Phrase Helper switch pathway and locked both helpers to their separate Home entry points.

12 September AUD/density/colour closure: Home, Itinerary and Reservations explicitly label secondary AUD amounts; sparse Journey/Vault/Settings/Budget panels are content-driven; semantic colours are carried into secondary views.
13 September S23 Vault simplification: locked state now shows only The Vault header/vault door and Access Denied; triple-tap moved to the header and all lock hints/status/preview cards were removed.

13 September S23 header forensic pass: Home/stay/page headers use one restrained live border authority; Journey History and Checklist trim the legacy edge baked into their artwork so the same single live border is visible without a double frame.
13 September S23 App Health pass: ambulance mark, functional whole-app check and animated ECG pulse treatment verified at both approved iPad sizes.
